# aether_registry_cleanup_policy (Resource)

A cleanup policy of the organization's registry: artifacts matching ALL `conditions` in the repositories matched by `repo_scope` are deleted (or protected) on `schedule`. A policy with `action = "delete"`, a `nightly` or `weekly` schedule and `enabled = true` is due immediately and the platform runs it within about a minute of the apply. Test with `action = "protect"` or `enabled = false` first. `protect` policies are not consulted by the scheduler today (aether-api#309). Policies survive destroying `aether_registry`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `conditions` (Attributes List) Conditions an artifact must ALL satisfy. Per `type`: `age` — `op` `gt` or `lt`, `value` `<N>d` or a Go duration (`720h`); `tag_count` — `op` `gt` (keep the N newest), `value` a non-negative integer; `tag_name` — `op` `eq`, `matches` or `not_matches` (Go regular expression), `value` non-empty; `untagged` — no `op`, `value` `"true"` or `"false"`, REQUIRED: the platform evaluates an untagged condition without a value as false, which matches every TAGGED artifact (it fails open, aether-api#311). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--conditions))
- `name` (String) Policy name (not required to be unique).

### Optional

- `action` (String) `delete` or `protect`. Defaults to `delete`.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the scheduler runs the policy. Defaults to `true`.
- `repo_scope` (Set of String) Repository globs the policy applies to; empty (the default) means all repositories. A glob containing `/` matches the full repository name, otherwise the last path segment.
- `schedule` (String) `nightly`, `weekly` or `manual`. Defaults to `nightly`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Cleanup policy UUID.
- `last_run_at` (String) Time of the last run (RFC 3339); null until the policy has run.
- `last_run_deleted` (Number) Artifacts deleted by the last run; null until the policy has run.
- `last_run_freed_bytes` (Number) Bytes freed by the last run; null until the policy has run.
- `updated_at` (String) Time the policy was last written (RFC 3339); runs move it too.

<a id="nestedatt--conditions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `conditions`

Required:

- `type` (String) `age`, `tag_count`, `tag_name` or `untagged`.

Optional:

- `op` (String) Comparison operator; allowed values depend on `type`. Must be omitted for `untagged`.
- `value` (String) Operand, always written as a string; the format depends on `type`.
